notes: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe now rolls a die for every player before new matches. Highest roll starts; tied players reroll. Online, the winner becomes X without changing host authority. Animated dice and a brief move lock show the result; offline games also roll, so the computer can start. Existing games keep their boards, turns and players. Includes SoundCloud public track/playlist playback, volume, mute, repeat and compact game dock from 1.0.40.
